## Welcome

Welcome to the **Slidecrafting** workshop! Over the next two hours we will learn how to
craft functional and aesthetically pleasing slides using [Quarto](https://quarto.org/)
reveal.js presentations.

::: {.callout-note}
This workshop is a hands-on companion to the [Slidecrafting book](https://slidecrafting-book.com).
:::

## What you will learn

- How a reveal.js `.qmd` file is put together, and the YAML options worth knowing
- How to theme slides with sass variables for fonts, colors, and sizes
- How to position elements on a slide and modify the standard ones
- How to use fragments, write your own, and match elements with auto-animate
- How to install and use Quarto reveal.js extensions

## Before you arrive

Please complete the [setup](setup.qmd) steps so you are ready to go.
